comment: Random events (GDD 10.2, stage 3h). Every turn each lived-in settlement may be struck by each event once. timesPer10000Years: how often the event strikes a settlement in 10 000 years with no condition (yearly chance = times / 10 000); over a turn of N years the chance is 1 - (1 - p)^N, at most once a turn. Events here are the big ones a settlement remembers, not every dry summer. conditions: kind humidity_below / humidity_above (value 0-100, the settlement's cell), river (a river on an edge of its cell), biome_near (one of biomes within value cells), people_at_least (value), settled (the settlement cannot move). A condition that holds multiplies the chance by percent (default 100; 0 rules the event out); a required condition that does not hold rules it out. softenedBy: a technology the owner knows lowers the strength of every effect by percent. effects: an effect type from effects.json with a strength and a duration in years; settlement and civilization effects fall on the struck settlement or its owner, cell effects on every land cell within radiusCells. When a turn is longer than the effect lasts, the effect stays for the whole turn with its strength scaled by years / turn years, so a short drought in a 50-year turn weighs little. fertilityGain: fertility points added to land cells within fertilityRadius (a flood's silt, up to 100). spreadPercent: the chance that each other settlement in the same trade network is struck too (an epidemic). chronicle: {settlement} and {civilization} are filled in.

events.name: Drought
events.chronicle: A drought dried the land around {settlement} ({civilization}).

events.name: Wildfire
events.chronicle: A wildfire burned the forests around {settlement} ({civilization}).

events.name: Flood
events.chronicle: The river flooded {settlement} ({civilization}); the silt left the fields richer.
